
Home (`/`) is the post-login destination. For a signed-in actor it shows the
Morning Brief and then the actor's projects as cards. A card is one link
carrying the project's identity, a role badge, a one-line signal ("2
approvals awaiting you", "You lead this project", "You are on this project"),
a counts strip with label text beside each number, up to five Crew initials,
and the last activity. Cards sort by tier (approvals awaiting the actor, then
projects the actor leads, then projects the actor is on), then last activity.
An actor on no project sees a link to all projects. With no signed-in actor
(an open instance) Home lists every project by last activity with no badge,
signal or brief.
